name: Luxembourg
headline: Luxembourg: +0.6% growth in 2025, 2.5% inflation, debt 27% of GDP
sections: Luxembourg is a $101 billion economy (2025), the world's 78th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +0.6% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $157K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 3.7% of GDP (2025).

Consumer prices rose 2.5% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 8.1% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 6.0% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 21.5% (2025).
Gross government debt is 27% of GDP (2025), a low level. The general government balance is −2.0% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is +4.8% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Trade equals 350% of GDP (2025), a highly open economy. Net FDI inflows were −32.7% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 40% of GDP by 2031, still rising from today's level. Life expectancy is 83.2 years (2024). Population: 682 thousand (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
